subject.title: Feishu: read image tool result loses media before final outbound payload

question: Should maintainers use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442 as the canonical shared fix for this issue, or refresh https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/50359 as the direct issue-specific PR?
rationale: The issue is valid and source-reproducible, but overlapping open PRs target the same media-promotion gap with different freshness and scope.

options.title: Use the current-file shared PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442 as canonical, have it explicitly reference this issue, and require its lint and real-behavior proof gaps before merge.

options.title: Refresh the direct PR
options.body: Ask https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/50359 to port from removed `pi-*` files into current files if maintainers prefer the reporter's issue-specific branch.

options.title: Split Feishu residuals
options.body: Keep this issue scoped to the read-image bridge while leaving direct Feishu `MEDIA:` and fallback-security work to the newer Feishu-specific issues.

recommendation.title: Use the current-file shared PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442 as canonical, have it explicitly reference this issue, and require its lint and real-behavior proof gaps before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent shared media pipeline history makes this the best available routing owner for choosing the canonical landing path.
